mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5%) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.3%) signals robust consumer demand, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or joint Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), weak labor market conditions reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 0.3%) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 45% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly housing starts growth (HOUST > 0.5%) and quarterly GDP expansion (GDPC1 > 1.5% QoQ) signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 55% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed thresholds, or joint Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve implements aggressive tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
